entry.title: Discrepancy in DMEE Format Name Displayed in F110 DME Administration
entry.content:
Hi Team,

We have created a new DMEE format Z_CITI_CN_CGI_XML_CT_1 by copying the existing DMEE format Z_CITI_CN_CGI_XML_CT.

The new format has been configured and assigned as follows:

  • Assigned to the relevant country payment method in FBZP.
  • Corresponding entries have been created and maintained in OBPM1, OBPM3, and OBPM4 with the format name Z_CITI_CN_CGI_XML_CT_1.
  • The payment method is configured to use the new DMEE format.

During testing in F110, the system consistently updates and uses the new format Z_CITI_CN_CGI_XML_CT_1 in the following locations:

  1. Proposal Log
  2. Environment → Payment Media → Attributes
  3. Table REGUT (field DTFOR)
  4. Generated DMEE/XML file details
  5. Runtime data observed during debugging (field FPAYHX-FORMI contains value Z_CITI_CN_CGI_XML_CT_1)
